'''Lloyd Howe''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Hoth North Ridge Regionals]] on 5 August 2000 with CC mains (no objective), according to Brent Holmstrom's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1106">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-09-hoth-north-ridge-calgary-canada-8-05-00d1106/ hoth-north-ridge-calgary-canada-8-05-00], DeckTech (Brent "Illithid" Holmstrom, 9 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-09-hoth-north-ridge-calgary-canada-8-05-00d1106/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
